description: Build the Wall Configuration Engine (wallConfigEngine.ts) with 8 Panel Fit algorithms, obstruction handling, and deterministic panel frame generation. Remove manual zone creation/drag/resize interactions. Update CanvasContainer and SelectionLayer to remove zone manipulation. Add new error codes E-WALL-001 through E-FIT-002 to error catalogue.
steps: 1. Create frontend/src/engines/wallConfigEngine.ts with: WallConfigInput type (wall_type: STRAIGHT|L_CORNER, total_width_mm, total_height_mm, rows, columns, panel_gap_mm, fit_algorithm: EQUAL|ADJUST_END_PANELS|SPREAD_LEFT|SPREAD_RIGHT|SPREAD_BOTH_ENDS|CENTRE_FOCUS|OUTER_FOCUS|ALTERNATING, fit_intensity_percent: 0-100, mounting_type, obstructions array, segment_a_width_mm optional, segment_b_width_mm optional)

2. Implement generatePanelFrames(config: WallConfigInput): PanelFrame[] - deterministic pure function that computes panel frame positions and dimensions from wall config parameters. Each PanelFrame has: frame_id (deterministic UUID based on row/col/config hash), row_index, col_index, x_mm, y_mm, width_mm, height_mm, segment (SEGMENT_A|SEGMENT_B|null), is_edge_panel boolean
3. Implement EQUAL fit algorithm: divide wall width equally by number of columns, minus gaps. All panels get identical width. Panel width = (total_width - (columns-1)*panel_gap) / columns
4. Implement ADJUST_END_PANELS: center panels use standard size, end panels absorb remainder. End panel sizes adjusted based on fit_intensity (0%=equal, 100%=max adjustment to ends)
5. Implement SPREAD_LEFT: leftmost panels narrower, progressive widening to right. Intensity controls how much spread
6. Implement SPREAD_RIGHT: rightmost panels narrower, progressive widening to left
7. Implement SPREAD_BOTH_ENDS: both end panels narrower, center panels wider. Symmetric
8. Implement CENTRE_FOCUS: center panels wider, outer panels narrower
9. Implement OUTER_FOCUS: outer panels wider, center panels narrower
10. Implement ALTERNATING: alternating wide/narrow panels based on intensity

11. Implement obstruction handling: each obstruction is {x_mm, y_mm, width_mm, height_mm, type: WINDOW|DOOR|PILLAR|CUSTOM}. Panels that would overlap an obstruction are excluded from generation. Apply Rule 69: minimum retained panel dimension is 50mm
12. Implement row logic: total_height divided by rows minus vertical gaps. Panel height = (total_height - (rows-1)*panel_gap) / rows
13. Apply Rule 63: panel_gap_mm is independent from SKU joint gaps (gh_mm/gv_mm). The gap in this engine is the structural spacing between frames, not the SKU joint gap
14. Apply Rule 69: if any generated panel frame dimension is below 50mm, throw EngineError
15. Remove frontend/src/canvas/interactions/useZoneCreate.ts (delete file)
16. Remove frontend/src/canvas/interactions/useZoneDrag.ts (delete file)
17. Remove frontend/src/canvas/interactions/useZoneResize.ts (delete file)

18. Update frontend/src/canvas/CanvasContainer.tsx: remove useZoneCreate import and usage, remove zone creation preview rectangle, remove zone creation from mouse handlers. Keep marquee select for viewing.

19. Update frontend/src/canvas/layers/SelectionLayer.tsx: remove 8-point resize handles entirely (no useZoneResize import, no handles array/rendering). Keep selection outline and marquee rect for viewing selected zones.

20. Update frontend/src/canvas/interactions/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts: remove Delete/Backspace handler for zone deletion (Rule 65 - Designer cannot delete zones). Keep Escape for deselect, keep Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Shift+Z for undo/redo (now applies to wall config changes). Remove Ctrl+C/V/D copy/paste/duplicate for zones. Remove arrow key nudge.

21. Update frontend/src/canvas/layers/ZonesLayer.tsx: keep the rendering but zones are now read-only in both DESIGNER and CONSULTANT mode. Remove the click-to-select in DESIGNER mode for editing purposes (keep selection for SKU viewing). Add a visual indicator that zones are system-generated.

22. Add new error codes to frontend/src/engines/errorCatalogue.ts: E_WALL_NO_DIMENSIONS ('E-WALL-001'), E_WALL_INVALID_GEOMETRY ('E-WALL-002'), E_WALL_GAP_EXCEEDS_SPACE ('E-WALL-003'), E_FIT_PANEL_BELOW_MIN ('E-FIT-001'), E_FIT_INTENSITY_INVALID ('E-FIT-002')

23. Create frontend/src/engines/__tests__/wallConfigEngine.test.ts with comprehensive tests: test all 8 fit algorithms, test obstruction exclusion, test minimum 50mm rule, test deterministic output (same input = same output), test L_CORNER with segments, test edge cases (1 column, 1 row, max columns)
24. Update frontend/src/engines/index.ts to export wallConfigEngine
acceptance_criteria: wallConfigEngine.ts exports generatePanelFrames function that deterministically produces PanelFrame arrays
All 8 fit algorithms are implemented and produce valid panel layouts
Rule 69 enforced: panels below 50mm throw EngineError
Rule 63 respected: panel_gap_mm is the frame-level gap, separate from SKU gh_mm/gv_mm
useZoneCreate.ts, useZoneDrag.ts, useZoneResize.ts files are deleted
CanvasContainer no longer has zone creation interaction
SelectionLayer no longer has resize handles
Keyboard shortcuts no longer include Delete for zones or arrow nudge
Existing tests that relied on deleted interactions are updated or removed
verification: unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit
unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd frontend && npx vitest run
